title: Hamilton–Jacobi Equation
description: A first-order partial differential equation for Hamilton's principal function in classical Hamiltonian mechanics. Its coordinate derivatives give canonical momenta, while its time derivative is minus the Hamiltonian evaluated at those momenta.

relations.note: Endpoint variation of the action evaluated on stationary classical trajectories yields the equation.
Describes the leading classical-action equation in suitable semiclassical approximations, not exact quantum evolution.
